# Micah 1 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The LORD gave this message to Micah of Moresheth during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah. These are the visions he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

**2** Listen, all you people! Pay attention, earth and everyone in it! The Sovereign LORD is making accusations against you from His holy Temple.

**3** Look! The LORD is coming! He leaves His throne in heaven and tramples the heights of the earth.

**4** The mountains melt beneath His feet and the valleys split apart, like wax too close to a flame, like water cascading down a hillside.

**5** And why is this happening? Because of the rebellion of Israel — the sins of the whole nation. Who is to blame for Israel's rebellion? Samaria! And where is the center of idolatry in Judah? Jerusalem!

**6** "So I will make Samaria a heap of rubble — an empty field for planting vineyards. I will roll her stones down into the valley and strip her down to her bare foundations.

**7** All her carved idols will be smashed. All the wages she earned from prostitution will be burned up. I will destroy every idol, because she collected them through prostitution, and to prostitution they will return."

**8** Because of this I will weep and wail. I will walk around barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.

**9** For Samaria's wound is too deep to heal. It has spread all the way to Judah — right to the gates of Jerusalem itself.

**10** Don't announce it in Gath! Don't even weep! In Beth-le-aphrah, roll in the dust in mourning.

**11** March off as captives, you people of Shaphir — stripped and ashamed. The people of Zaanan dare not come out. The mourning in Beth-ezel means you've lost your safe haven.

**12** The people of Maroth anxiously wait for relief, but only bitterness awaits, for the LORD has sent disaster to the very gates of Jerusalem.

**13** Harness your warhorses to your chariots, people of Lachish! You were the first city in Judah to follow Israel into sin. The sins of Israel can be traced to you.

**14** So send your farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath. The town of Achzib will turn out to be a mirage for Israel's kings.

**15** And as for you, people of Mareshah — I will send a conqueror to capture your town. The leaders of Israel will flee to the cave at Adullam.

**16** Shave your heads in mourning for the children you love. Make yourselves as bald as an eagle, for your children will be snatched away into exile.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **1:3-4**: When God shows up, the landscape itself can't handle it. Mountains melt, valleys crack open. This isn't gentle imagery — Micah wants you to feel the earth-shaking weight of divine judgment.

- **1:5**: Micah names names. It's not 'sin in general' — it's Samaria, it's Jerusalem. The capital cities, the centers of power, are ground zero for the nation's corruption.

- **1:8**: The prophet doesn't just announce judgment — he embodies it. Walking around barefoot, wailing like an animal. He's not detached from the message; it's destroying him too.

— PNEUMA
